The watch is a Cartier Santos-Dumont, small/large model, steel case, blue alligator leather strap, silver dial with Roman numerals. Reference: WSSA0022 (large steel Santos-Dumont with blue strap? Actually WSSA0022 is the Santos-Dumont large steel with blue alligator strap). Let me think.

Santos-Dumont large model steel: WSSA0022 — steel, silver dial, blue alligator strap. Yes, WSSA0022 is the large Santos-Dumont in steel with blue alligator strap. WSSA0023 is the small model with blue strap? Actually WSSA0023 is the small Santos-Dumont steel with blue alligator strap. The photo shows a fairly large watch with two hands, no date, quartz? The Santos-Dumont large (WSSA0022) is quartz? No — the large Santos-Dumont is quartz... Let me recall: Santos-Dumont large model WSSA0022 has a quartz movement (Cartier caliber 057). Yes, the extra-large Santos-Dumont WSSA0022 is quartz. Actually the Santos-Dumont XL (WSSA0022) is quartz movement. The small WSSA0023 also quartz. The larger men's Santos-Dumont "large" model has automatic? Hmm.

Cartier Santos-Dumont history: relaunched 2018 with quartz movements in the small and large sizes (WSSA0022 large steel, WSSA0023 small steel). Actually the 2018 launch had two sizes: small (WSSA0023) and large (WSSA0022), both quartz. Then in 2020, the XL with automatic movement WGSA0021 (gold) etc. Hmm, the XL is 46.6mm. The large is 43.5mm x 31.4mm.

The photo proportions: appears large with two hands, no seconds, no date — consistent with quartz Santos-Dumont large or small. I'll go with WSSA0022 (large, steel, blue alligator strap). Confidence ~0.45.

Movement: quartz for WSSA0022. Case material stainless steel. Bracelet leather (alligator).
